metadata.author: Research Team
metadata.description: Proteus coding task surveys with AI intent display study

pre_survey.title: Pre-Study Survey
pre_survey.description: Please answer the following questions before starting the coding task. All questions are required.

questions.question: What is your current education level?
How much experience do you have in programming?
questions.help_text: 1 = No experience, 2 = Beginner (< 6 months), 3 = Intermediate (6–24 months), 4 = Advanced (2–4 years), 5 = Expert (4+ years or professional)

questions.question: How familiar are you with Large Language Models, Generative AI, AI coding assistants, or GitHub Copilot?
How frequently do you use AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or other coding agents?
questions.help_text: 1 = Never, 2 = Rarely (once a month or less), 3 = Occasionally (a few times a month), 4 = Frequently (a few times a week), 5 = Very frequently (daily or almost daily)

post_survey.title: Post-Study Survey
post_survey.description: Thank you for completing the task! Please share your experience with the AI coding assistant. All questions are required.

questions.question: How frequently did you change your code to align the AI's intention with yours?
Why did you trust or distrust the AI's suggestion or guess? Please describe.
questions.placeholder: Describe factors that increased or reduced your trust (e.g., correctness, clarity, past performance, uncertainty cues).

questions.question: Describe how your trust in the AI's suggestion or guess changed when its suggestion conflicted with your intended approach.
questions.placeholder: Explain whether your trust increased, decreased, or stayed the same—and why.

questions.question: Describe the strategies you used while coding to help the AI produce better suggestions or guesses.
questions.placeholder: E.g., clarifying prompts, restructuring code, adding comments/tests, smaller steps, specifying libraries.
